audience.primary: Product designers and AI engineers building human-facing AI products
audience.priorKnowledge: Experienced with digital products but not assumed to know interaction or emotional-design theory
audience.decisionContext: Design an AI product that people can understand, use to accomplish a real goal, and want to return to

learningObjective.outcome: Explain and apply the Understand, Accomplish, Care framework synthesized from the three declared sources
learningObjective.evidenceOfLearning: The viewer can use the framework to diagnose one unfamiliar AI-product experience and identify a concrete design improvement

audiencePromise.viewer: Product designers and AI engineers building human-facing AI products
audiencePromise.problem: A technically capable AI product can still be confusing, poorly aligned with user goals, or emotionally unrewarding.
audiencePromise.promisedOutcome: A source-grounded three-part framework for making AI products understandable, useful, and worth returning to.
audiencePromise.boundary: The episode is a bounded thematic synthesis and reading guide, not a complete substitute for the three books or a guarantee of product success.
audiencePromise.subscriptionReason: Follow the complete journey from AI-product design through testing, adoption, marketing, and go-to-market decisions.
